_comment: The realm answers The Guest of the King's Hall (Gabriel, 12/10/2026: the war is declared because of the player's act and everyone knows it; the queen's return to her husband is the condition of peace). The tale names the king as {husband}; where a realm is meant, a role stands for the realm that hero belongs to. A rule plays only when all it does can happen: no war between realms already at war, no peace between realms at peace. Held back with the queens (Extras/RealmQueens, Gabriel 18/10/2026).

rules.message: {husband} declares war on {player}, who has taken his queen {giver} from his court.
{giver} is returned to {husband}, and the king makes peace as he swore he would.
